clips.title: A Name and a Classroom
clips.script: Hello. My name is Lan Nguyen. I am a new student. My English class is in Room 12, next to the library. The class starts at eight thirty. Please bring a blue notebook.

questions.prompt: Who is speaking?
questions.rationale: The speaker introduces herself as Lan Nguyen.

questions.prompt: What should the student bring?
questions.rationale: The final sentence asks the student to bring a blue notebook.
